title: Could you please add model support for gpt-4o-mini-search-preview-2025-03-11?
body:
### What happened?

**Describe the bug**
I get a model not found error when trying to use this model from openAI

**To Reproduce**
Try using this model: gpt-4o-mini-search-preview-2025-03-11 in agent chat assistant agent.  The output is:

 ERROR holodeck.llm.single_agentid-1746733866500-9960: ValueError: The agent name must be a valid Python identifier. Error: model_info is required when model name is not a valid OpenAI model


**Expected behavior**
This model is supported in agent chat since it is under the completions api

This should be easy to just add this model support under your model list but I did not see it there


### Which packages was the bug in?

Python AgentChat (autogen-agentchat>=0.4.0)

### AutoGen library version.

Python 0.4.8

### Other library version.

_No response_

### Model used

gpt-4o-mini-search-preview-2025-03-11

### Model provider

OpenAI

### Other model provider

_No response_

### Python version

3.12

### .NET version

None

### Operating system

None
